Etsy sellers, before you panic about the new AI image rules… READ THIS. 👇 Etsy is NOT banning AI-generated images or mockups across the board. But there are some important distinctions sellers need to understand. Here's what you need to know: ✨ AI-generated digital products are still permitted when they meet Etsy's Creativity Standards, including disclosure requirements. ✨ Print-on-demand sellers can still use qualifying mockups, but your images need to accurately represent the product your customer will receive. ✨ Handmade and physical product sellers have stricter photo requirements. Not every AI-generated lifestyle image is acceptable as a replacement for real product photography. #etsysellersoftiktok #etsysmallbusiness #printondemand #fyppp #etsymockups

Etsy told ABC News exactly where its AI line is: sellers may use AI as a tool, but not to deceive buyers, misrepresent an item, or copy the work of others. I turned that into five checks and ran them on my own Etsy shop, live. One listing failed, and I fixed it on camera. Here's my score, and the 40-minute audit to run on your top 10 listings tonight. 💬 Comment "VAULT" and I'll send you this week's free niche research 👇 (or grab it here: https://everythingamazon.gumroad.com/l/plyan) 🔑 The SUSPEND Pack (the 10-listing audit grid, AI disclosure lines you can paste, and the takedown proof checklist) is in the Top Research Design Vault: https://everythingamazon.gumroad.com/l/TopResearchDesignVault ✅ THE 5 CHECKS (run them on your top 10 listings): 1. DISCLOSURE: does the description say AI was used? (Etsy's Creativity Standards require it.) 2. PRODUCTION PARTNER: is your print partner listed, and does "ships from" match reality? 3. PHOTOS: do the photos show what the buyer actually gets (colors, options, personalization)? 4. NOT A COPY: Google Lens your design + search your exact phrase in quotes on Etsy. 5. NO SAMENESS: search your own shop. Five near-identical listings look like a prompt mill. 📊 MY SCORE: 4/5. My listing "Jingle Spurs" had AI art with hand-finished lettering and NO AI line in the description. Check 1 failed. I added this line on camera and published it: "Design created by me with the help of AI image tools, then edited and finished by hand. Printed and shipped by my production partner." Then I added it to every other listing that was missing it. All 18 now disclose AI. 🔧 SHOP STOPPED MOVING? Before you blame the algorithm, run the 5 checks on your 10 best sellers. A missing disclosure or a mismatched photo is the easiest thing to fix and the hardest thing to argue in an appeal. 💬 Is AI-assisted art real art: yes, no, or it depends on the human part? Tell me below. ⏱ CHAPTERS 0:00 Etsy's AI line, in its own words 0:18 Three tests → five checks 1:03 Live audit: disclosure + production partner 1:51 Live audit: photos + the copy check 2:50 Check 5 + my score 3:15 If your shop stopped moving 4:02 What Etsy didn't say 4:23 Is AI-assisted art
